title: Disclaimer
intro: This Disclaimer explains the limitations of liability for using [SMMGen](/about-us) and its [SMM panel](/) services. Please read this page carefully before using our platform or placing any orders.
body:
## General Disclaimer

SMMGen provides social media marketing services including followers, likes, views, comments, and engagement across platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram, LinkedIn, Spotify, and others.
We have operated since 2018 and served users in over 100 countries worldwide. While we work hard to deliver fast and reliable results on every order, no service in the social media marketing industry can guarantee permanent or algorithmic outcomes.
By using smmgen.com, you accept the terms of this Disclaimer in full.

## No Guarantee of Specific Results

SMMGen delivers the quantity of followers, likes, views, or engagement specified in each service description. We do not guarantee any specific business outcome, revenue increase, viral growth, or algorithmic boost as a result of using our services.
Social media platform algorithms change frequently and without notice. Results such as increased reach, monetization eligibility, or content virality depend on many factors outside our control, including your content quality, posting frequency, and audience behavior.
We deliver what we promise on the order. What happens beyond that delivery is subject to each platform's own systems.

## Third-Party Platform Disclaimer

SMMGen is an independent service provider. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Telegram, LinkedIn, Spotify, X (formerly Twitter), or any other social media platform referenced on this website.
All platform names, logos, and trademarks mentioned on smmgen.com belong to their respective owners. We reference them solely to describe the services we offer.
Use of our services is subject to the terms of service of each social media platform. It is your responsibility to review and comply with those terms before placing an order. SMMGen is not liable for any action taken by a social media platform against your account.

## No Platform Liability

Social media platforms including Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and others reserve the right to remove followers, likes, views, or other engagement from any account at any time. This can happen as part of routine platform audits, algorithm updates, or enforcement of their own terms of service.
SMMGen is not responsible for any removal of delivered engagement by a third-party platform. Where applicable, we offer a refill guarantee on eligible services. See our Refund Policy for full details on refill eligibility.

## Account Risk Disclaimer

Purchasing social media services carries a degree of risk that varies by platform and service type. Some platforms prohibit the purchase of followers, likes, or views under their terms of service.
SMMGen does not access your social media account passwords or login credentials at any point. All services are delivered using your public profile or post URL only.
However, you accept full responsibility for any consequences that arise from using our services on your social media accounts. SMMGen is not liable for account restrictions, suspensions, or bans imposed by any social media platform.
We recommend reviewing the terms of service of each platform before ordering.

## Accuracy of Information on This Website

SMMGen updates the content on smmgen.com regularly. However, we do not warrant that all information on this website is complete, current, or error-free at all times.
Service descriptions, pricing, delivery times, and feature availability may change without prior notice. Always check the service listing in your dashboard for the most current information before placing an order.
If you find any information on smmgen.com that appears inaccurate or outdated, contact us at smmgen.com/contact-us and we will review it promptly.

## External Links Disclaimer

smmgen.com contains links to external websites, including social media platforms, payment processors, and third-party tools. These links are provided for convenience only.
SMMGen does not control the content, accuracy, or availability of any external website. We are not responsible for the content, privacy practices, or terms of any site you visit after leaving smmgen.com.
Clicking an external link from smmgen.com is done at your own risk. We recommend reviewing the terms and privacy policy of any external site before using it.

## Limitation of Liability

To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, SMMGen and its team members, partners, and service providers are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of smmgen.com or our services.
This includes but is not limited to loss of revenue, loss of data, loss of followers or engagement after delivery, account restrictions imposed by third-party platforms, or any other loss resulting from your use of our platform.
Our total liability to any user in any circumstance is limited to the amount paid for the specific order in dispute.

## Indemnification

By using smmgen.com, you agree to indemnify and hold SMMGen, its team, and its partners harmless from any claims, damages, losses, or expenses arising from your use of our services, your violation of any platform's terms of service, or your breach of any part of our Terms and Conditions.

## Professional Advice Disclaimer

Nothing on smmgen.com constitutes legal, financial, marketing, or business advice. All content published on this website, including blog posts, service descriptions, and guides, is provided for general informational purposes only.
If you need advice specific to your business, legal situation, or financial circumstances, consult a qualified professional in the relevant field.

## Changes to This Disclaimer

We update this Disclaimer when our services change or when required by applicable law. All updates appear on this page with a revised "Last updated" date at the top.
We recommend reviewing this page periodically, especially before placing large or bulk orders on smmgen.com.

## How to Contact Us

For any questions about this Disclaimer, reach the SMMGen team through the channels below.

We aim to respond to all queries within 48 hours.
